reason: The C0 freeze required W10/W11 to construct a fresh deterministic C2 W0 certificate but did not freeze the evidence_roots value used by the existing C2 certificate transcript. Without this rule, two correct independent C3 certificate checkers could derive different C2 certificate_id values from arbitrary diagnostic roots.

rule.c2_certificate: Fresh C2 W0 preservation certificate has exactly one evidence_roots entry equal to this derived evidence_root; all other C2 fields are reconstructed from claim, exact artifact/program and independently rederived projected REALIZE.
rule.authority: The evidence root is a deterministic binding/diagnostic root only. It creates no independent authority.

compatibility: No frozen C3 semantics, F0/G1/R0 result, W7/W8/W5/W6 implementation, or descriptor space changes.
